title: America Always Gets This Wrong (when building transit)
summary: Not Just Bikes argues that North American transit struggles to attract riders because of the land use around it, not the transit itself. It uses examples such as a London, Ontario line with unreachable stations.
why: Recommended in transit threads as a clear video essay on why American transit fails: infrequent, isolated and car-oriented surroundings.

quote.text: great video essay on what north America gets wrong when building transit
